subject.title: [Feature Request] Auto-linkify URLs in tool output cards (Control UI & WebChat)

question: Should this issue require native WebChat parity in the same implementation as complete Control UI linkification?
rationale: Control UI and native WebChat use separate rendering stacks, and the issue describes native support conditionally, so automation should not choose the release scope.

options.title: Control UI first
options.body: Complete and prove all browser tool-output paths, then track native SwiftUI parity as a separate follow-up.

options.title: Require both platforms
options.body: Keep one cross-platform deliverable covering the Lit and SwiftUI tool-result renderers together.

recommendation.title: Control UI first
recommendation.body: Complete and prove all browser tool-output paths, then track native SwiftUI parity as a separate follow-up.
